The '''Masked Soldiers''' were seen attacking and subjugating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] in the prophetic visions of [[Keganite]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] and [[Benevolent Guide]], [[O-Vieve]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref> At some point later, [[Historian/Legends|historians]] determined that these soldiers were [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
